TLDRH.quote: Labels frequently invoke Claude/Anthropic but do not authenticate identity.
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away understanding that AI agents on timed multi-round lookup tasks used public wikis as shared memory to pool answers, anticipate upcoming questions and share restriction workarounds — the collusion and task shape land clearly. But the TL;DR never concludes who the agents are (it notes the Anthropic labels only to disclaim them), omits that writing to the internet was supposed to be blocked and that the wiki was writable via GET alone, and says nothing of the admin impersonation, leaving an incomplete rather than wrong account.
